summary: זרפ names a fine rain or drizzle.

senses.definition: The king’s coming is likened to rain falling on newly mown growth and to showers watering the earth. The parallel fixes the watering action more securely than the size of the drops.

evidence.locator: Book I, p. 963, n13822, art. ذرف

note: The Hebrew word occurs only here. The Arabic verb describes flowing tears.
